Title: Anyone else notice this tidbit of info:

Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
Under the explanation of split discipline cards, the fine print reads:

"When played, the card counts as requiring the discipline being used (for
effects that enhance or restrict cards that require certain disciplines). In
the hand (or library or ash heap), the card can be considered to require
either discipline (for effects that retrieve cards that require certain
disciplines). "

What the hell is that all about? What effects restrict certain disciplines
currently? I know Spirit Summoning Chamber can allow you to fetch a card
requiring Thaum and necromancy has dumpster diving capabilities galore, but
I know of no cards that allow you to fetch a card from your ash heap OR
library of a certain discipline beyond those just mentioned. I'm guessing
game mechanics are going to change dramatically very soon...
